# eVisit Blog

> eVisit's blog covers virtual care strategy, telemedicine implementation, compliance, and best practices for healthcare providers.

The eVisit Blog is the official resource hub for telehealth and virtual care information, featuring industry insights, product updates, compliance guidance, and practical strategies for medical practices adopting remote care technologies. Content spans patient engagement, practice management, regulatory compliance, and emerging telemedicine trends.

## Key Topics

- Virtual Care
- Telemedicine
- Telehealth
- Patient Engagement
- Virtual Care Compliance
- Healthcare Technology
- Practice Management
- Medical Practice
- Best Practices
- Healthcare Strategies
- ATA Conference
- State Telemedicine Policy
- Specialty Care
- Urgent and Primary Care
- Employee Care

## Virtual Care Strategy & Best Practices

- [How to Increase Patient Engagement: 25 Ideas & Strategies](https://blog.evisit.com/virtual-care-blog/25-creative-ways-increase-patient-engagement): Guide with 25 strategies to increase patient engagement in virtual care
- [Telehealth vs Conventional Medical Treatment: How Telemedicine Improves the Patient Experience and Lowers Patient Costs](https://blog.evisit.com/virtual-care-blog/telehealth-vs-conventional-medical-treatment-how-telemedicine-improves-the-patient-experience-and-lowers-patient-costs): Comparison of telehealth and conventional treatment on patient experience and costs
- [Physician First: Why Healthcare Technology Should Be Provider Driven](https://blog.evisit.com/virtual-care-blog/why-healthcare-technology-should-be-provider-driven): Article on provider-driven healthcare technology design philosophy at eVisit
- [4 Types of Telemedicine Providers](https://blog.evisit.com/virtual-care-blog/telemedicine-providers): Classification of four main types of telemedicine providers in healthcare
- [Top Specialties Using Telehealth, Children with Chronic Conditions Benefit from Telehealth + Industry Update](https://blog.evisit.com/virtual-care-blog/top-specialties-using-telehealth-children-with-chronic-conditions-benefit-from-telehealth): Industry update on telehealth specialties and pediatric chronic condition benefits
